name: Linux Diagnostics MCP Server
description: This MCP server provides read-only Linux system diagnostics tools for inspecting system information, processes, and log snapshots. It enables AI models to analyze Linux system health, troubleshoot issues, and review security through workflow prompts and HTTP transport with API key authentication.
